item.title: Show HN: Librario, a book metadata API that aggregates G Books, ISBNDB, and more
item.description:
📝 TLDR: Librario is a book metadata API that aggregates data from Google Books, ISBNDB, and Hardcover into a single response, solving the problem of no single source having complete book information. One might provide the series, the other might provide genres, and another might provide a good cover, but none provided everything. It fetches information about books from multiple sources (Google Books, ISBNDB, Hardcover.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46571149
